content:
maria: Heads up — we have a cluster of Reserved Instances for GPU types expiring in ~45 days (us-west-2, 12 x p4d.24xlarge + 8 x a100-80gb equivalents). If we do nothing coverage drops ~38% for GPU spend. Wanted to kick off options: ladder vs exchange vs convert to Savings Plan.
raja: Can you paste the specific reservation IDs and current usage patterns? need to see peak vs base. :eyes:
infra-bot: Reservation summary: 
- RI group: gpu-prod-usw2-2022 
- Instances: p4d.24xlarge (12), a100-80gb (8) 
- Expiry: 45d 
- Monthly committed hours: 25,920 
- Current avg utilization (30d): 71% 
Link: https://console.internal/redwood/inventory/ri/gpu-prod-usw2-2022
maria: Thanks infra-bot. Quick notes: utilization is uneven — training jobs spike on Tues/Thu nights, but baseline batch inference holds steady. Finance flagged that spend hit quota last quarter so we should avoid a big coverage gap.
olivia: Two high-level approaches: 1) Convert a portion to Savings Plans for cross-instance flexibility (good if we expect region/shape churn). 2) Ladder renewals: stagger multiple smaller RIs/commitments to avoid big re-ups all at once.
matt: For GPUs convertible RIs are limited (cloud vendor restrictions). If we need shape flexibility, Savings Plans often win. Also consider exchanging some p4d into smaller size-flex pool if size-flexible applies.
elena: From procurement side: 1yr convertible vs 3yr standard — 3yr gives more discount but longer lock. Timing: procurement needs a decision 21 days before expiry to process discounts. Also check amortization and CAPEX/opex treatment.
raja: I'll run a quick utilization slice by weekday/time and by model tag to quantify how much is baseline vs burst. SQL I'd use: ```
SELECT cluster, model_tag, SUM(instance_hours) as hours, AVG(utilization) as avg_u 
FROM infra.gpu_usage 
WHERE instance_type IN ('p4d.24xlarge','a100-80gb') AND ts >= now()-interval '30 days'
GROUP BY cluster, model_tag
ORDER BY hours DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
raja: Posting preliminary numbers in ~2h.
maria: Proposed risk-tolerant plan (draft): 
- Move 50% of current capacity to a 1yr Savings Plan (region-flex) to cover baseline inference.
- Ladder remaining 50% into two staggered 1yr convertible RIs (6 and 18 months) to allow shape/region migration.
- Keep 10% buffer of on-demand / burst swap in Dedicated pool for spikes.
Want feedback on %s.
matt: I like splitting baseline to SP + ladder for the rest. But check math: SP often saves less on long tail of training runs where big discounts from RIs kick in. Run a unit-economics calc: effective $/GPU-hour across our mix.
finance-bot: Cost delta calc helper: https://billing.redwood/tools/commitment-calculator 
elena: Also check convertible exchange fees and whether vendor supports instance-family exchange for GPU SKUs — some families aren't supported. If exchange disabled, SP is the only flexible option.
olivia: Also consider region shift: we have spare capacity in us-east-1 for burst. If we migrate some jobs we can buy targeted RIs there and trade cross-region with SP. But migration ops cost needs to be included.
raja: Preliminary utilization split: baseline (steady inference) ~42% of hours, scheduled training ~38%, ad-hoc experiments ~20%. If baseline is 42% we should ensure SP covers at least that to maximize flexibility.
maria: OK action items: 
- raja: run 90d utilization and hourly heatmap and list top 5 model tags driving training. (ETA: EOD today)
- matt: run unit-econ calc comparing 1yr conventional RI, 1yr convertible RI, and 1yr regional Savings Plan for p4d vs smaller shapes. (ETA: 48h)
- elena: check procurement timelines and any early-exchange penalties, confirm latest vendor policy for GPU family exchange. (ETA: 3 business days)
- olivia: draft laddering plan numbers (percentages + timing) to propose at decision meeting. (ETA: 48h)
maria: Decision meeting scheduled Thu in 10 days, 10:00 PT. If we can get numbers, we'll pick between SP-heavy vs RI-ladder. :thumbsup:
raja: starting queries now. will paste results here.
matt: FYI if we go SP-heavy we'll need to update cost allocation tags so finance attributes correctly. small ops ask.
elena: Also suggest we run a canary: purchase a small convertible RI now (1-2 instances) to validate exchange path + tagging flows before committing large amounts.
maria: Good call — add canary purchase to plan. Thanks all.
